title: Generic deepwater FPSO: oil production with gas reinjection
purpose: Learning case for process safety and barrier risk. Typical design values, not any operator's facility.

fluid.note: GOR is derived from 340 MMscf/d gas / 210,000 bbl/d oil. H2S and CO2 are ASSUMED for learning (slightly sour).

basisOfDesign.assumptionNote: Capacities from public sources for an Erha-class FPSO. All operating conditions are typical values, marked ASSUMED.

systems.name: Oil separation and treatment
systems.description: Three-phase HP separation, LP flash, heating with hot oil, electrostatic dehydration, cooling to cargo tanks.
majorHazards: Gas blowby from HP to LP separator
Loss of containment of hot crude

systems.name: Gas compression (LP and HP)
systems.description: LP flash gas compressed to HP separator pressure, combined gas compressed to TEG contactor pressure.

systems.name: Gas dehydration (TEG)
systems.description: Gas dried by triethylene glycol in a contactor. Rich TEG is flashed, heated and regenerated in a still column with a hot-oil reboiler. Mirrors the coursework amine unit.

equipment.name: TEG reboiler (hot oil)
equipment.note: TEG degrades above about 204 °C. Reboiler temperature control is a quality and safety limit.

equipment.name: Still vent KO drum / BTEX condenser

majorHazards: Regenerator overpressure (loss of cooling or blocked vent)
Gas blowby from contactor to flash drum

systems.name: Gas reinjection compression
systems.description: Dry gas compressed to reservoir injection pressure. Fuel gas is taken off upstream.
majorHazards: High-pressure gas release and jet fire

systems.name: Fuel gas
systems.description: Dry gas let down to 25 barg, superheated and filtered for the gas turbines.
majorHazards: Overpressure of fuel gas system on let-down valve failure

systems.name: Produced water treatment
systems.description: Water from separators treated by hydrocyclones and a degassing / flotation unit, then discharged overboard within the local oil-in-water limit.

systems.name: Seawater injection
systems.description: Seawater lifted, filtered, sulphate removed, deaerated and pumped to injection wells.

systems.name: Hot oil system
systems.description: Waste heat recovery on gas turbine exhausts heats hot oil. Hot oil serves the crude heater and TEG reboiler. Links to the coursework hot oil HAZOP.
majorHazards: Hot oil leak above autoignition temperature
Process gas leaking into hot oil via tube rupture

systems.name: Power generation
majorHazards: Fuel gas leak in turbine enclosure

systems.name: Flare
systems.description: HP and LP flares with flare gas recovery for normally zero flaring. Receives PSV and blowdown flows.

equipment.name: Flare tower with HP and LP tips

majorHazards: Flare KO drum liquid overfill (burning liquid rain-out)

systems.name: Cargo tanks and offloading
systems.description: Crude stored in cargo tanks under inert gas. Offloaded via floating hoses to a CALM buoy.

systems.name: Riser balcony and manifolds
systems.description: Production, gas injection and water injection risers hang off the port side balcony.
majorHazards: Riser rupture with full inventory release

systems.name: Accommodation, temporary refuge, helideck, lifeboats
systems.description: Living quarters for 100 people, temporary refuge, helideck and lifeboats, at the stern away from the flare.
majorHazards: Smoke or gas ingress into temporary refuge

riskCriteria.note: Example scenario frequency targets for LOPA, for learning. Companies set their own.

bySeverity.description: Single fatality or major environmental release
Lost time injury or significant release

personnelSafetyTasks.task: Hot work (welding) on a pipe support in the separation module
key: Gas test before and during work
Check SIMOPS conflicts (no venting, no offloading start)

personnelSafetyTasks.task: Confined space entry into a cargo tank for inspection
key: Gas free and ventilate (O2, LEL, H2S, benzene)
Isolate inert gas and cargo lines with blinds

personnelSafetyTasks.task: Crane lift of a compressor spare over live plant
key: Avoid lifting over risers and live hydrocarbon lines

personnelSafetyTasks.task: Tandem offloading to a shuttle tanker via CALM buoy
key: No hot work or helicopter ops during offloading (SIMOPS)
